# ODS bundled Source 4.3.45 candidate

Functional source commit: `1b1b34771ad2ad7778ddccd6574626afbaf8a39b`.

A Windows/WSL installation of the previous candidate listed a synthetic
Los Angeles all-day event on the preceding evening and omitted it on the
evening it occupied. The native count returned one for the latter interval.

The list now resolves all-day boundaries in the calendar's timezone. When
older projection data cannot resolve the timezone, a possibly overlapping
event is marked uncertain. Distant date-only records leave unrelated queries
complete. The registered-tool tests exercise the exclusive end and both sides
of the 25-hour Los Angeles day and the Kathmandu offset. The same eight
intervals passed on Linux x64, Windows x64 and an Apple silicon Mac with the
functional commit's list and count modules. These were synthetic events.
Connected Portal chat on a known empty and nonempty calendar remains open.
